# Intentional differences from pinned Reviung41

Reference: `tests/fixtures/upstream/reviung41/` (verbatim, never edited), commit
`edf5c0814fd3ea202e43aad2d68fd32e882a518c`, ZMK v0.3.0. Compare Kconfig forms,
chosen layout, matrix transform, gpio-matrix properties and keymap layer structure.
Geometry follows `_shared-includes/physical_layouts.dtsi` and documented attrs.

- A complete six-key 2×3 macropad instead of the folded 41-key 7×6 Reviung41. Name is
  Unibody six / unibody_six; keys remain in project-array order.
- 011: portable pro_micro connector pins (rows D2/D6, columns D8/D9/D10).
  Legacy raw-pin projects migrate to physically equivalent connector contacts. Same col2row input pulldowns and wakeup.
- Inline 1u unrotated geometry, spaced at 2u, instead of shared rotated Reviung geometry.
  Chosen physical-layout selects transform and kscan; no chosen matrix-transform.
- Base/Fn layers, simpler supported key presses and layer behaviors, plus self-contained
  tap-dance/mod-morph from docs/zmk/behaviors.md §3.2–3.3. No unsupported RGB settings.
  display-name on layers for readability; identical custom definitions share labels.
- Only used bt/outputs headers, no rgb header, and no redundant modifiers include (keys.h
  includes it). One item per line, four-space indentation, LF, one final newline.
- Kconfig forms unchanged aside from names and omitted upstream copyright preamble;
  our newly authored output is not a verbatim upstream file. No display/RGB defaults.
- Conf is a comment stating defaults; no user settings exist yet. No RGB board override,
  .zmk.yml, module metadata, workflow, west.yml or build.yaml (009 is preview only).

Golden text was authored before generator implementation; it is an approved adapted
reference, not a snapshot generated by the implementation and not firmware build evidence.

`row2col.overlay` is an independently authored polarity variant of the same preset: only diode-direction and input GPIO pull flags change, according to the pinned matrix binding. Other four files remain identical.
